gen-audiowide-gf-arsenal-sc: Audiowide holds one uniform line through every joint, never thinning or bulging, which is its whole display swagger. Arsenal SC takes the quieter job, a plain sans with a faint swell on its curves.
gen-audiowide-gf-asimovian: Tiled and futuristic: Audiowide lays its glyphs out with wide grout lines and tall lowercase. And Asimovian, the sans-serif beneath, keeps an approachable feel, building every letter from one stroke width.
gen-audiowide-gf-basic: Futuristic from the first glyph, Audiowide keeps a tube-like, constant-width stroke and tall lowercase beside its capitals. Basic is clean and low, with a gentle bump up to capitals.
gen-audiowide-gf-cal-sans: Audiowide's glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout lines, and no stroke ever thins or swells. But Cal Sans is modern and approachable, a single stroke width and tall x-height making it the friendlier half.
gen-audiowide-gf-carlito: Futuristic and tile-like, that is Audiowide at first glance, tall lowercase and all. Carlito takes over with tightly spaced, open round letters, so paragraphs of text read clearly at small sizes.
gen-audiowide-gf-courier-prime: Audiowide sets glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines and no thick-thin shift, a proper display face. And Courier Prime, a monospace drawn with a steady drafting-pen line, is the precise, structured one.
gen-audiowide-gf-geist-mono: Audiowide builds every glyph like a tile with wide grout lines, with no thick-thin shift and a tall lowercase. Geist Mono's fixed-width, code-style letters feel structured and technical beside it.
gen-audiowide-gf-hammersmith-one: Audiowide never thickens or thins a stroke, and its tall lowercase sits in tile-like glyphs with wide grout lines. Hammersmith One keeps rounded, cord-like strokes, with capitals barely taller than lowercase.
gen-audiowide-gf-inder: Audiowide sets tiled, futuristic glyphs with wide grout lines and an unmodulated line across every glyph. Inder moves smoothly through text, with very little height difference between its cases.
gen-audiowide-gf-krona-one: Wiry and futuristic, Audiowide sets tile-like glyphs apart with wide grout lines and tall lowercase. But Krona One is the approachable one, loosely spaced, with a lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals.
